# ==============================================================================
# 0. Embedded deps (AHK2 zip Base64; 快捷键4.ahk via remote irm)
# ==============================================================================
$ahk2_bin_zip_A11111 = ''

# ==============================================================================
# 1. 寻找合适的磁盘（优先寻找非 C 盘的第一个可用固定硬盘）
# ==============================================================================
$targetDrive = Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk |
    Where-Object { $_.DriveType -eq 3 -and $_.DeviceID -ne 'C:' } |
    Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty DeviceID

if (-not $targetDrive) {
    $targetDrive = "C:"
}
Write-Host "1. 确定目标安装盘符" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "   -> 已选择盘符: $targetDrive" -ForegroundColor White


# ==============================================================================
# 2. 创建目录结构
# ==============================================================================
Write-Host "2. 创建目录结构" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# 基础路径: X:\helpme\command_ext
$baseDir    = Join-Path $targetDrive "helpme\command_ext"
# AHK 根目录: X:\helpme\command_ext\ahk
$ahkDir     = Join-Path $baseDir "ahk"
# AHK 安装包解压目标路径: X:\helpme\command_ext\ahk\ahk_install2
$installDir = Join-Path $ahkDir "ahk_install2"

if (-not (Test-Path $baseDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $baseDir -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Host "   -> 成功创建基础目录: $baseDir" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "   -> 基础目录已存在: $baseDir" -ForegroundColor Gray
}

if (-not (Test-Path $installDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $installDir -Force | Out-Null
    Write-Host "   -> 成功创建 AHK 解压目录: $installDir" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "   -> AHK 解压目录已存在: $installDir" -ForegroundColor Gray
}


# ==============================================================================
# 3. 处理 AHK2 压缩包
# ==============================================================================
Write-Host "3. 解压 AHK2 压缩包" -ForegroundColor Cyan

if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ahk2_bin_zip_A11111) -or $ahk2_bin_zip_A11111.StartsWith('在此')) {
    Write-Warning "   -> [$] ahk2_bin_zip_A11111 变量为空或未替换，跳过 AHK 压缩包处理！"
} else {
    try {
        $zipPath = Join-Path $installDir "ahk2_temp.zip"

        Write-Host "   -> 正在解码 Base64 数据..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        $zipBytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($ahk2_bin_zip_A11111.Trim())
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($zipPath, $zipBytes)

        Write-Host "   -> 正在解压至: $installDir" -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Expand-Archive -Path $zipPath -DestinationPath $installDir -Force

        Remove-Item -Path $zipPath -Force
        Write-Host "   -> AHK2 解压完成！" -ForegroundColor Green
    } catch {
        Write-Error "   -> 处理 AHK2 压缩包时发生错误: $_"
    }
}


# ==============================================================================
# 4. Download AHK script source -> write 快捷键4.ahk
# ==============================================================================
Write-Host "4. Download AHK script" -ForegroundColor Cyan

try {
    $scriptUrl  = "https://tmzcloud.github.io/demo/%E5%BF%AB%E6%8D%B7%E9%94%AE4.ahk"
    $scriptPath = Join-Path $baseDir "快捷键4.ahk"
    Write-Host "   -> fetching: $scriptUrl" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    $scriptText = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $scriptUrl
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($scriptText)) {
        throw "remote content empty"
    }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($scriptPath, $scriptText, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false))
    Write-Host "   -> saved: $scriptPath" -ForegroundColor Green
} catch {
    Write-Error "   -> download AHK script failed: $_"
}

Write-Host "==========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "环境初始化流程执行完毕！" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "==========================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
